# gpcn_datacenters (Data Source)

Retrieves information about available GPCN™ data centers. Use this data source to filter and find data centers by name, country, or region.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Example: Querying GPCN™ data centers
#
# This example demonstrates how to query available data centers by location.
# Data centers are used when creating resources like networks, volumes, and
# virtual machines to specify where they should be deployed.

terraform {
  required_providers {
    gpcn = {
      source  = "Global-Private-Cloud-Network/gpcn"
      version = "~>1.5.0"
    }
  }
}

provider "gpcn" {}

# Example 1: Query data centers in East US region
data "gpcn_datacenters" "east_us" {
  country_name = "United States"
  region_name  = "east"
}

# Example 2: Query data centers in West US region
data "gpcn_datacenters" "west_us" {
  country_name = "United States"
  region_name  = "west"
}

# Example 3: Query all data centers in a country
data "gpcn_datacenters" "all_us" {
  country_name = "United States"
}

# Example 4: Query data centers that support GPUs
data "gpcn_datacenters" "gpu_capable" {
  gpu_enabled = true
}

# Example 5: Query GPU-capable data centers in a specific region
data "gpcn_datacenters" "gpu_capable_east_us" {
  country_name = "United States"
  region_name  = "east"
  gpu_enabled  = true
}

# Example 6: Query data centers that support custom images
data "gpcn_datacenters" "custom_image_capable" {
  custom_images = true
}

# Example 7: Query data centers that offer VPC networking
data "gpcn_datacenters" "vpc_capable" {
  vpc_capable = true
}

# Example 8: Query data centers that offer layer-2 segments
data "gpcn_datacenters" "l2_capable" {
  l2_capable = true
}

# Output the first data center ID from East US
output "east_us_datacenter_id" {
  description = "ID of the first data center in East US"
  value       = data.gpcn_datacenters.east_us.datacenters[0].id
}

# Output all East US data center details
output "east_us_datacenters" {
  description = "All data centers in East US region"
  value       = data.gpcn_datacenters.east_us.datacenters
}

# Output count of data centers in West US
output "west_us_datacenter_count" {
  description = "Number of data centers in West US region"
  value       = length(data.gpcn_datacenters.west_us.datacenters)
}

# Output all GPU-capable data center IDs
output "gpu_capable_datacenter_ids" {
  description = "IDs of all data centers with GPU support"
  value       = [for dc in data.gpcn_datacenters.gpu_capable.datacenters : dc.id]
}

# Output all data centers supporting custom images
output "custom_image_datacenter_ids" {
  description = "IDs of all data centers that support custom images"
  value       = [for dc in data.gpcn_datacenters.custom_image_capable.datacenters : dc.id]
}

# Output all data centers that offer VPC networking
output "vpc_capable_datacenter_ids" {
  description = "IDs of all data centers that offer VPC networking"
  value       = [for dc in data.gpcn_datacenters.vpc_capable.datacenters : dc.id]
}

# Output all data centers that offer layer-2 segments
output "l2_capable_datacenter_ids" {
  description = "IDs of all data centers that offer layer-2 segments"
  value       = [for dc in data.gpcn_datacenters.l2_capable.datacenters : dc.id]
}
```

## Schema

### Optional

- `country_name` (String) Filter data centers by country name (e.g., 'United States', 'Canada').
- `custom_images` (Boolean) Filter data centers to only those that support custom images.
- `gpu_enabled` (Boolean) Filter data centers to only those with GPU support enabled.
- `l2_capable` (Boolean) Filter data centers to only those that offer layer-2 segments.
- `name` (String) Filter data centers by name
- `region_name` (String) Filter data centers by region name within a country. (e.g., 'East', 'West', 'Central')
- `vpc_capable` (Boolean) Filter data centers to only those that offer VPC networking.
- `vpn_capable` (Boolean) Filter data centers to only those that offer site-to-site VPN.

### Read-Only

- `datacenters` (Attributes List) List of data centers matching the specified filter criteria. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--datacenters))

<a id="nestedatt--datacenters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `datacenters`

Read-Only:

- `code` (String) Short code that identifies the data center.
- `continent_code` (String) Code of the continent where the data center is located (e.g., 'NA').
- `continent_name` (String) Name of the continent where the data center is located.
- `country_abbreviation` (String) Two-letter country code abbreviation (e.g., 'US').
- `country_id` (String) Unique identifier of the country where the data center is located.
- `country_name` (String) Name of the country where the data center is located.
- `custom_images` (Boolean) Whether custom images are supported in this data center.
- `gpu_enabled` (Boolean) Whether GPU resources are available in this data center.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the data center.
- `l2_capable` (Boolean) Whether layer-2 segments are available in this data center.
- `name` (String) Name of the data center.
- `region_id` (Number) Numeric identifier of the region where the data center is located.
- `region_name` (String) Name of the region where the data center is located.
- `vpc_capable` (Boolean) Whether VPC networking is available in this data center.
- `vpn_capable` (Boolean) Whether you can create site-to-site VPN gateways and connections in this data center.
